items: Thank you for showing up when I needed it. You did not have to, and you did it anyway. I will not forget it.
Thank you for your help yesterday. You saved me hours of trouble and a lot of worry.
You listened when I was not making much sense. Thank you for your patience and your time.
Thank you for standing by our family through a difficult month. Your support carried us.
I asked for a small favour and you did a big one. Thank you, truly.
Thank you for the lift, the tea and the company. All three were needed.
Thank you for the lovely gift. It is exactly my taste, and I have already started using it.
Thank you for having us over. The food was wonderful and the evening even better. Next time at our place.
Thank you for the sweets. They did not last the evening. Please take that as a compliment.
Thank you for making us feel at home. We came as guests and left as family.
Thank you all for the birthday wishes. Reading them was the best part of my day.
Thank you for your wishes and blessings on our anniversary. We feel very loved.
Thank you, everyone, for your congratulations. Your good wishes mean a lot to our family.
Thank you for remembering. A message from you always makes the day better.
Thank you, Ma'am, for the extra time you gave my child before the exams. It made all the difference.
Thank you, Doctor, for your care and your patience with all our questions. We are grateful.
Thank you for covering for me last week. I owe you one, and I mean to pay.
Thank you for your guidance on the project, Sir. I learnt a lot from the way you handled it.
Thank you to the whole team for the effort this week. It was noticed, and it is appreciated.
आपकी मदद के लिए दिल से धन्यवाद। आप न होते तो यह काम इतनी आसानी से न होता।
जन्मदिन की शुभकामनाओं के लिए आप सबका बहुत बहुत धन्यवाद। आपके संदेशों ने दिन बना दिया।
इतने प्यारे तोहफ़े के लिए शुक्रिया। इसे देखकर हर बार आपकी याद आएगी।
मुश्किल वक़्त में साथ देने के लिए धन्यवाद। यह एहसान नहीं, रिश्ता है, और मैं इसे याद रखूँगा।
आपकी मेहमाननवाज़ी के लिए शुक्रिया। खाना लाजवाब था और बातें उससे भी बढ़कर।
सर, आपके मार्गदर्शन के लिए आभारी हूँ। आपसे बहुत कुछ सीखने को मिला।
डॉक्टर साहब, आपकी देखभाल और धैर्य के लिए हमारा पूरा परिवार आपका आभारी है।
ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਮਦਦ ਲਈ ਦਿਲੋਂ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ। ਔਖੇ ਵੇਲੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਾਲ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ, ਇਹ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਭੁੱਲਾਂਗੇ।
ਜਨਮ ਦਿਨ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਧਾਈਆਂ ਲਈ ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ।
ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤੋਹਫ਼ੇ ਲਈ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ ਜੀ। ਬਹੁਤ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਇਆ।
ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਮਹਿਮਾਨ ਨਿਵਾਜ਼ੀ ਲਈ ਸ਼ੁਕਰੀਆ। ਰੋਟੀ ਵੀ ਸੁਆਦ ਸੀ ਤੇ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਵੀ।
I am sorry I was not there when you needed me. You deserved better from me. I would like to make it right.
I said something careless yesterday and it hurt you. I am sorry. It will not happen again.
Sorry for cancelling at the last minute, again. Your time matters. Let me plan the next one, and I will be early.
I forgot your birthday, and I have no good excuse. I am sorry. Can I take you out this week?
I should have listened and I kept talking. I am sorry. Tell me again. This time I will hear you.
I am sorry for raising my voice. Whatever the argument was, you did not deserve that tone.
I was wrong, and I knew it while I was arguing. I am sorry. Can we talk this evening?
Sorry I have been on my phone more than with you. I noticed. I am putting it down.
I am sorry I forgot what you asked me to do. It was important to you, so it should have been important to me.
Sorry, Maa. I spoke rudely this morning. I was stressed, and I took it out on you. That was wrong.
Papa, I am sorry I did not call for so long. I have no excuse. I will call every Sunday from now on.
I am sorry I missed the family function. I know it mattered. I will come home next weekend.
Sorry, didi. I borrowed it without asking and I should have asked. I will replace it.
I apologise for the delay in sending the report. It was my oversight. You will have it by 5 pm today.
I am sorry for the mistake in the file. I have corrected it and checked the rest. The revised copy is attached.
Apologies for missing the meeting. I have read the notes and will complete my action points by tomorrow.
We are sorry for the trouble with your order. We are fixing it today and will update you by evening.
I apologise for my tone in the meeting. Your point was fair, and I should have heard it out.
मुझसे गलती हुई है और मैं दिल से माफ़ी माँगता हूँ। आगे से ध्यान रखूँगा।
कल मैंने जो कहा, वह नहीं कहना चाहिए था। मुझे माफ़ कर दो।
माँ, सुबह मैंने ऊँची आवाज़ में बात की। गलती मेरी थी। माफ़ कर दीजिए।
तुम्हारा जन्मदिन भूल गया, इसका कोई बहाना नहीं है। सॉरी यार। इस हफ़्ते की पार्टी मेरी तरफ़ से।
देरी के लिए क्षमा चाहता हूँ। काम आज शाम तक पूरा करके भेज दूँगा।
नाराज़गी जायज़ है। जब मन करे तब बात करना, मैं इंतज़ार करूँगा।
I passed our old tea stall today and missed you more than I expected. Call me when you are free.
It has been too long. I miss the kind of laughing we do only with each other.
Life got busy, but I have not stopped missing you. Let us fix a date this month.
Miss you, yaar. The group is dull without your terrible jokes.
Maa, the food here is fine, but it is not yours. Missing you and your kitchen today.
Papa, I heard your favourite old song today and wished I was home. Missing you.
The house is too quiet since you left for the hostel. We miss you, beta. Eat well and call often.
Missing home today: the noise, the smell of tadka and all of you talking at once.
Bhai, the house has no one to fight with since you left. Come home soon.
I miss you in the small moments: the morning tea, the drive back, the last hour of the day.
Counting days till you are back. The house knows you are away. So do I.
Miss you. Nothing dramatic. Things are just better when you are in the room.
Distance has taught me how much I like being near you. Come back soon.
आज आपकी बहुत याद आ रही है। फ़ुरसत मिले तो फ़ोन कीजिएगा।
माँ, आपके हाथ की चाय की याद आ रही है। जल्दी घर आऊँगा।
यार, तेरे बिना महफ़िल सूनी है। कब आ रहा है?
घर की याद आती है तो सबसे पहले आप सबके चेहरे याद आते हैं।
दूरी सिर्फ़ शहरों की है, दिल तो वहीं है। तुम्हारी याद आ रही है।
बेटा, घर सूना सूना लगता है। ठीक से खाना और रोज़ एक फ़ोन ज़रूर करना।
ਤੇਰੀ ਬੜੀ ਯਾਦ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ ਯਾਰਾ। ਕਦੋਂ ਮਿਲਣਾ?
ਮਾਂ, ਪਰਦੇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰੇ ਹੱਥ ਦੀ ਰੋਟੀ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
ਪਿੰਡ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਆਈ ਤਾਂ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਚੇਤੇ ਆਏ। ਛੇਤੀ ਮਿਲਾਂਗੇ।
ਪੁੱਤ, ਘਰ ਤੇਰੇ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਸੁੰਨਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰੋਜ਼ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਕਰਿਆ ਕਰ।
No reason for this message. I was thinking of you and wanted you to know.
Home is not the address. It is wherever you are waiting.
Thank you for today: the tea, the patience, the way you laughed at dinner.
I like who I am when I am with you. That is your doing.
You handled a lot today. I saw it. Proud of you, and coming home early.
After all these years, your call is still the one I pick up fastest.
Eat on time, drink water and come home soon. This is a love letter. It only looks like instructions.
Different cities, same moon, same thoughts. Good night from far away.
The best part of my day is still the ten minutes we talk. Do not hang up early today.
The distance is temporary. What we have is not.
We have built a home, raised worries and paid bills together. I would not want any other partner for any of it.
You are my favourite person to do nothing with.
I do not say it enough: I am lucky. Thank you for being mine.
Growing old does not scare me, as long as it is next to you.
आज बिना वजह तुम्हारी याद आई, सोचा बता दूँ।
तुम साथ हो तो साधारण दिन भी अच्छा लगता है।
घर वही है जहाँ तुम इंतज़ार करते हो।
ज़िंदगी की भागदौड़ में तुम मेरा ठहराव हो।
समय पर खाना खा लेना। इसे ही मेरा प्यार समझना।
बरसों बाद भी तुम्हारी हँसी सुनकर दिन बन जाता है।
You know all my stories, and you still ask "then what happened?" That is friendship.
Thank you for being the person I do not have to perform for.
You are the first person I want to tell good news to, and bad news too.
We have not changed. We have only become more expensive versions of the same fools.
Friends like you make the hard years shorter.
I found our old class photo today. Same faces in my head, even now. How are you?
It has been years, and I would still know your laugh in a crowd. Let us talk soon.
No reason for this message, except that a good memory of us came up. Hope you are well.
We lost touch, not the friendship. I am picking it up from here. Hello again.
You did not ask questions. You just came. I will remember that all my life.
Some people give advice. You gave time. Thank you, my friend.
When things went wrong, your number was the one I dialled. Thank you for picking up.
दोस्त वह है जिसके सामने सोचकर नहीं बोलना पड़ता। तू वही है।
पुरानी तस्वीर देखी तो तेरी याद आ गई। कैसा है यार?
बरसों बाद भी बात वहीं से शुरू होती है जहाँ छोड़ी थी। यही तो दोस्ती है।
मुश्किल में सबसे पहले तेरा नंबर मिलाया, और तूने उठाया भी। शुक्रिया दोस्त।
तेरी दोस्ती वह उधार है जो मैं कभी चुकाना नहीं चाहता।
ਯਾਰ ਉਹ ਜੋ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਕਹੇ ਸਮਝ ਜਾਵੇ। ਤੂੰ ਉਹੀ ਹੈਂ।
ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫ਼ੋਟੋ ਵੇਖੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਚੇਤਾ ਆ ਗਿਆ। ਕੀ ਹਾਲ ਹੈ ਸੱਜਣਾ?
ਯਾਰੀਆਂ ਕਮਾਈਆਂ ਜਾਂਦੀਆਂ ਨੇ, ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡੀ ਕਮਾਈ ਹੈਂ।
Get well soon. Rest properly and let everything else wait. No need to reply to this.
Heard you are unwell. Thinking of you and wishing you a quick, easy recovery.
Take all the time you need to get better. We are here, and so is the soup.
Get well soon! The group is boring without you, so hurry, but only after proper rest.
Sending you good wishes and the strict instruction to rest. Doctor's orders first, ours second.
Glad to hear you are back home from the hospital. Step by step now. We are with you.
Wishing you strength for the surgery and a smooth recovery after it. We are praying for you.
I am cooking for your family this week. Do not argue. Just get better.
Wishing you a speedy recovery. Work is covered, so please rest without worry.
Get well soon. The team is managing, though not as well as when you are here.
Take care of your health first. Everything at the office can wait until you are well.
Get well soon, little champ. Your toys are waiting and so are your friends.
Brave children get better fast. Take your medicine, rest, and we will play soon.
जल्दी ठीक हो जाइए। आराम कीजिए, बाकी सब हम देख लेंगे।
आपकी तबीयत का सुनकर चिंता हुई। ईश्वर से प्रार्थना है कि आप जल्द स्वस्थ हों।
दवा समय पर लेना और पूरा आराम करना। जवाब देने की ज़रूरत नहीं।
ऑपरेशन अच्छे से हो जाए और आप जल्दी घर लौटें, यही दुआ है।
अस्पताल से घर आने की खबर सुनकर अच्छा लगा। अब धीरे धीरे सब ठीक हो जाएगा।
बेटा, जल्दी से ठीक हो जाओ। फिर साथ में पार्क चलेंगे।
ਛੇਤੀ ਠੀਕ ਹੋ ਜਾਓ ਜੀ। ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੰਦਰੁਸਤੀ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇ।
ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਸਿਹਤ ਬਾਰੇ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਫ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੋਇਆ। ਆਰਾਮ ਕਰੋ, ਬਾਕੀ ਕੰਮ ਅਸੀਂ ਸਾਂਭ ਲਵਾਂਗੇ।
ਅਰਦਾਸ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਛੇਤੀ ਰਾਜ਼ੀ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਆਓ।
I am so sorry for your loss. I am thinking of you and your family.
I heard the sad news. No words are enough. Please know that I am with you.
My deepest condolences. May you find strength in the love of the people around you.
I am sorry. There is no need to reply. I just wanted you to know I am here.
We are heartbroken to hear the news. Our prayers are with your whole family.
I am very sorry about your father. He was a good man, and he was proud of you. I saw it every time he spoke of you.
Your mother's kindness touched everyone who came to your home. I am so sorry for your loss.
Losing a parent is losing a part of home. I am sorry. I am here for whatever you need.
Uncle always asked about my studies and remembered the answers. I will miss him. My condolences to all of you.
I cannot imagine what you are going through. I am here, today and in the months ahead.
There are no words for a loss like this. We are holding your family in our prayers.
Please accept my sincere condolences on your loss. Take all the time you need. Work will be looked after.
Our whole team is sorry for your loss. We are thinking of you and your family.
यह दुखद समाचार सुनकर बहुत दुख हुआ। ईश्वर दिवंगत आत्मा को शांति दे और परिवार को यह दुख सहने की शक्ति दे।
इस कठिन घड़ी में हम आपके साथ हैं। हमारी गहरी संवेदनाएँ।
अंकल जी का स्नेह हम कभी नहीं भूलेंगे। ईश्वर उनकी आत्मा को शांति प्रदान करे।
शब्द कम पड़ रहे हैं। बस इतना जानिए कि हम आपके दुख में शामिल हैं।
माँ जी की कमी कोई पूरी नहीं कर सकता। ईश्वर आपको धैर्य दे। ओम शांति।
किसी भी चीज़ की ज़रूरत हो तो बेझिझक कहिएगा। हम साथ खड़े हैं।
ਇਹ ਦੁੱਖ ਭਰੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਅਫ਼ਸੋਸ ਹੋਇਆ। ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਿਛੜੀ ਰੂਹ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇ।
ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਣ ਦਾ ਬਲ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇ। ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ਰੀਕ ਹਾਂ।
ਬਜ਼ੁਰਗਾਂ ਦਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਸਦਾ ਚੇਤੇ ਰਹੇਗਾ। ਇਸ ਔਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਸੀਂ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਨਾਲ ਹਾਂ।
That was a hard blow, and you are allowed to feel it. When you are ready to plan, I am here.
One bad result does not cancel years of effort. Rest this week. We start again on Monday.
You tried something difficult. Most people never do. I am proud of you for that alone.
The door that closed was one door. You have opened harder ones before.
Losing the job says something about the company's budget. It says nothing about your worth. Let us update your CV together.
You have been carrying a lot for a long time. It is all right to be tired. You are doing better than you think.
You do not have to solve the whole year today. Just today's part.
Slow progress is still progress. Keep going at your own speed.
I see how hard you are working, even on the days nobody says so.
Take a day off from being strong. I will hold things for a bit.
You have prepared for this. Walk in like you belong there, because you do.
Nervous means it matters. Breathe. You will be fine.
Whatever happens in that room, you will come out as the same capable person. Go.
You are not a burden. Call me at any hour. I mean it.
I do not have answers, but I have time and tea. Come over.
No need to talk. I am just checking that you ate today.
यह दौर मुश्किल है, मानता हूँ। पर तुम अकेले नहीं हो, मैं साथ हूँ।
एक नाकामी पूरी कहानी नहीं होती। थोड़ा आराम करो, फिर साथ में नई शुरुआत करेंगे।
थक गए हो तो रुक जाओ, पर हार मत मानो।
तुम्हारी मेहनत मैंने देखी है। नतीजा देर से आएगा, पर आएगा ज़रूर।
आज का दिन निकल जाए, बस इतना काफ़ी है। कल की कल देखेंगे।
जब मन भारी हो, फ़ोन कर लेना। समय की चिंता मत करना।
हिम्मत रखो। रात कितनी भी लंबी हो, सुबह होती ही है।
Bad day? It has only a few hours left. You have many more. You win.
Today was rude to you. I have noted it. Tomorrow has been informed.
Come over. I have tea, snacks and zero advice.
The day went badly. You did not. There is a difference.
Close the laptop. Nothing good is decided after a day like this. Dinner first.
I cannot fix your day, but I can send you a silly photo of myself. Say the word.
Bad days make good stories later. This one will be a great story.
Reminder: you have survived all your worst days so far. A perfect record.
Rough day? Come home. The world can be dealt with tomorrow.
You do not have to talk about it. Sit with me. I made your tea the way you like it.
Whatever went wrong today, we are fine. You and me. That part is solid.
That meeting was hard. You handled it with more patience than I would have. Tea is on me.
Tough day at work. It was the day, not you. See you tomorrow, fresh start.
आज का दिन खराब था, तुम नहीं। चाय पियो, सब ठीक हो जाएगा।
मूड खराब है? चलो, गोलगप्पे खाने चलते हैं। बाकी बातें बाद में।
दिन बुरा हो सकता है, ज़िंदगी नहीं। कल नया दिन है।
ज़्यादा मत सोचो। आज जल्दी सो जाओ, सुबह सब हल्का लगेगा।
बस एक मुस्कान दे दो, बाकी दिन को मैं डाँट दूँगा।
Good morning, Sir. I have a fever since last night and will not be able to come in today, [date]. I will check messages for anything urgent. Thank you.
